limitations: This validates the selected mesh overload on Lewiner-generated input meshes, not JIST-generated meshes; the latter are a separately measured substitution.
The selected wrapper's serialized VTK/NIfTI output adapters and full pipeline are not exercised.

The overall comparison fails: Java and Python choose different equidistant outer faces at an exact folded-surface tie, producing a 0.0457 mm return-distance difference. The central projection also has 21 nearest-triangle/vertex selection differences and up to 0.307 mm projected-thickness difference. Java uses float32 triangle arithmetic plus source KD traversal ordering; Python uses float64 geometry and centroid-tree ordering. This report records the unresolved source-ordering deviation; it is not hidden by the looser surface-position tolerances.

Minimal EmbeddedSurface, ThicknessSolver, JIST progress, image-only overload, and unused Jama import stubs support compilation; source thickness methods are compiled unchanged.
